services.desc: At Mega Bite we are dedicated to helping you have an exceptional fishing adventure. Mega Bite Fishing Charters have many packages available. For applications, morning and noon are the best time to go out because that is when the trout are the most active. Night fishing is better farther in the season. As for the tourism side, Mega Bite Fishing Charters have multiple boats to take out for trips. Mega Bite’s boats are huge with big cabins, perfect for any outing you want to plan. Working in conjunction with Sport Fish Michigan, we will be offering select dates in late April and May during the peak of the annual Detroit River walleye run.
